fields.mechanism: Industrial fluid dynamics monitoring system using pressure wave pattern recognition
fields.intervention: Integrate acoustic emission sensors along the infusion tubing that analyze pressure wave signatures characteristic of occlusion events
fields.expected_effect: Enhanced detection of partial and complete occlusions by recognizing distinct acoustic patterns associated with flow restriction, while differentiating them from normal flow variations
fields.falsification_test: Expose the system to various occlusion scenarios (partial, complete, intermittent) with different fluid viscosities and flow rates, measuring sensitivity and specificity against known occlusion events
fields.mechanism_source_span: (No direct source span in paper - this is a cross-industry transfer from industrial fluid monitoring systems)

fields.mechanism: Passive pressure monitoring through integrated flow restriction
fields.intervention: Incorporate a microfluidic flow restriction element with pressure monitoring that responds to occlusion by creating a predictable pressure drop
fields.expected_effect: Enhanced occlusion detection with reduced false alarms by leveraging fluid dynamics principles rather than active pressure monitoring
fields.falsification_test: Measure pressure differentials across the flow restriction element at various viscosities and flow rates to establish a reliable occlusion detection threshold
fields.mechanism_source_span: "IDDS are generally regarded as safe and reliable, however there is potential for complications leading to clinically significant consequences"

fields.mechanism: Stepwise framework for troubleshooting intrathecal pump therapy
fields.intervention: Implement a systematic diagnostic algorithm that checks pressure patterns, flow rates, and occlusion detection thresholds across different viscosities and flow rates
fields.expected_effect: Improved detection of downstream occlusions before harmful pressure/volume delivery while maintaining acceptable false-alarm rates
fields.falsification_test: Test with simulated occlusions at various points in the system across the pump's specified viscosity and flow rate range, measuring detection time and false-positive rates
fields.mechanism_source_span: "we propose a stepwise framework for troubleshooting intrathecal pump therapy in the setting of non-baclofen medications."

fields.mechanism: Multi-modal pressure-flow monitoring with impedance-based occlusion detection
fields.intervention: Implement a hybrid fluidic-electrical sensing system that combines pressure monitoring with impedance measurement across the infusion pathway
fields.expected_effect: Enhanced detection of downstream occlusions by correlating pressure changes with electrical impedance variations, reducing false alarms while maintaining sensitivity across viscosity ranges
fields.falsification_test: Test with simulated occlusions at various flow rates and viscosities, comparing detection time and false alarm rates against current pressure-only systems
fields.mechanism_source_span: IDDS are generally regarded as safe and reliable, however there is potential for complications leading to clinically significant consequences, such as accidental overdose, withdrawal and neurologic injury

fields.mechanism: Stepwise framework for troubleshooting device malfunctions that includes organized approach to detection and intervention
fields.intervention: Implement a hierarchical occlusion detection system with multiple independent verification methods
fields.expected_effect: Improved detection of downstream occlusions before clinically harmful pressure/volume delivery while maintaining acceptable false alarm rates
fields.falsification_test: Simulate occlusion scenarios across viscosity and flow-rate ranges to measure detection time and false alarm rate
fields.mechanism_source_span: In cases of suspected device malfunction, it is important to have an organized approach to troubleshooting

failure_modes_invoked_sample: regime transition to turbulence altering calibration
